defects.locator: final.md:17; S05 governing condition in investigator/critic/reviser source-map.json
defects.finding: The proposal presents -00:00 as semantically different from Z under RFC 3339, while its source map acknowledges RFC 9557. RFC 9557 updates that exact convention: Z and -00:00 carry the same unknown-local-offset meaning; +00:00 remains distinct. The final does not declare a legacy-only timestamp profile.
defects.consequence: A future archive reader/importer following the proposed semantic distinction can interpret retained timezone information incorrectly. This is material to the explicit date-representation and retained-meaning obligations, even though both forms denote the same UTC instant.
defects.resolution_in_frozen_final: UNRESOLVED; critic did not catch it and reviser repeated it.
